strings: It seems like m_c can barely stay still as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/wriggle/wriggles} {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} whole body in excitement for the whole day.
m_c keeps purring to {PRONOUN/m_c/self} as an act of self soothing.
Some of m_c's Clanmates find themselves confused because of m_c running around the camp in small circles, seemingly chasing {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} tail.
m_c has been bouncing around camp, flicking {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} tail and ears constantly. r_c watches with a very amused purr at {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} excited stimming.
